exposure: TOLAC group vs. planned repeated CD group
outcome: Maternal complications (need for blood transfusion, uterine rupture, hysterectomy, admission to intensive care unit)
cohort: Women with three prior cesarean deliveries and at least one prior vaginal delivery
finding: TOLAC in women with three prior CD and at least one prior vaginal delivery was not associated with higher risk of adverse maternal or fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Of the 10 women who underwent TOLAC, nine had vaginal birth and one had CD for non-reassuring pattern.
